comparison.objective: Drive opposed tapered shims behind a door jamb until snug without bowing it; candidate replaces a harness connector.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual opposed wedge insertion and structural-gap force control versus connector unlatching and mating.
comparison.success_condition: PR defines orientation, overlap, snugness, jamb bow, release, and rest; candidate lacks any measurable service outcome or damage limits.
comparison.reason: Wedge loading and jamb deformation control are different from connector replacement.
